context: Two managers discuss a vendor change
purpose: Teach: ポートフォリオ/プリンター/返金/レジュメ/数式/パートナーシップ/概算/アフター

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 資産のポートフォリオ、来期の重点だ。
lines.en: Asset portfolio is our focus for next quarter.
lines.style: Clipped, business-like. Rapid-fire delivery. Eye contact steady. The tone of someone setting an agenda, not asking. Slight pause after the dash—checkpoint moment.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。古いプリンター、リースから買い切りに切替予定です。
lines.en: Understood. We're switching those old printers from lease to outright purchase.
lines.style: Attentive, slightly faster pace to keep up. Respectful but not deferential. The energy of someone checking boxes—efficient, competent. Light emphasis on the action items.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.style: Measured observation. Slight concern underneath but held steady. Not quite a question, not quite a statement—more like flagging something. Pause weight on the verb.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。応募者のレジュメ、選別しました。
lines.en: Right. I've gone through the applicant resumes.
lines.style: Efficient, direct. Delivers completion with quiet confidence. No extra flourish. The rhythm of someone who follows through and reports clearly.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: KPIの数式、改訂を。パートナーシップ案件、優先しよう。
lines.en: Revise the KPI formulas. Let's prioritize the partnership projects.
lines.style: Two directives stacked with clarity. First one slightly sharper—an edit, not a suggestion. Second one carries more weight, like this is the real priority. Deliberate spacing between them.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 概算、明日提示します。アフター対応、強化中。
lines.en: I'll have the estimates to you tomorrow. We're ramping up aftercare support.
lines.style: Steady commitment. First part quick and assured. Second part slightly slower—emphasis on the reinforcement, like this matters. Wraps cleanly but not rushed.
